description: This file defines the core service for a reactive agent system. It includes the implementation of the AgentService class which manages the agent's operation loop, handles execution of actions via tools, and manages communication with an AI chat service. It also sets up various tools like file reading/writing, time retrieval, and calculation functionalities, as well as managing agent steps and errors.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling agent-related errors, with specific error types and message formatting.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main reactive agent class managing steps, communication, and execution of actions.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main loop to process user input, communicate with chat service, and perform actions based on the agent's reasoning.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Records a step in the agent's process, including type, content, and timestamp.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes various tools (read/write file, get time, calculate, etc.) that the agent can utilize.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates mathematical expressions given as strings.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Splits an expression string into tokens for parsing.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses expressions based on operator precedence.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors within an expression, including parentheses and negatives.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified tool action based on the parsed command.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses string arguments for tool actions, handling quoted strings and commas.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content from a string based on specific XML tags.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the initial prompt including available tools and task instructions.
